rationale: S-0069-03 proposes probing the AIS+axon's electrical-sink contribution by varying the axon-stub length. t0075 (bio_realistic_ais_param_sweep) covers this directly as Stage 2 axis 8: axon length is swept across {0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0} mm. The 0.1 mm value is short enough to materially reduce the sink the t0069 1 mm axon imposed; the 2.0 mm value extends in the opposite direction; t0075 measures the resulting HWHM, vector-sum DSI, and peak rate sensitivity directly. Rejecting as covered.
